svg.aria-label: How to write ಮ: 3 strokes · 2 pen lifts · 7 movements
svg.title: Writing ಮ
svg.desc: 7 frames; frame N shows movements 1 to N of ಮ (kannada), the movement being added drawn in ink over the finished letter, whose outline is read from _fonts/NotoSansKannada-Static.ttf. Stroke order after Gopala Krishna A, Kannada-alphabet-ma.gif, animation of Kannada consonant ಮ, 42 frames, 4.2 seconds (Wikimedia Commons, 25 May 2016) <https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Kannada-alphabet-ma.gif>. Source note on variation: The CC BY-SA 4.0 animation writes ಮ in three pen-down runs: from the inner tip of the curl the pen winds up and round to the left, runs along the base, rises into the middle point, drops round the right lobe and climbs the right side, curving over at the top (frames 0–11); after a lift, the top bar from left to right curling up into the hook (frames 15–19); after a second lift, the right bowl from its foot, round its base and up its right side, curling in at the top (frames 22–27). The frames were read from a mirror copy that matches the Commons file's listed size (244×236, 141 KB) and byte size. The path is fitted to the bundled Noto Sans Kannada outline rather than copying the animation's handwritten proportions; in that outline the right side of the body runs up into the bar instead of curving over, so the climb ends at the bar, but the two-lift order remains the same.
svg.text: How it is written — 3 strokes · 2 pen lifts · 7 movements

text.tspan: and curl in at the top

svg.text: Stroke order after Gopala Krishna A, Kannada-alphabet-ma.gif, animation of Kannada consonant ಮ, 42 frames, 4.2 seconds (Wikimedia Commons, 25 May 2016)
This order is attested, not standardised; the source records where it varies.
